lgs4056h_ds.title: LGS4056H Input High Withstand Voltage 1A Linear Lithium Battery Charger
lgs4056h_ds.doc: LGS4056H Product data sheet (as linked by LCSC for C5124109)
lgs4056h_ds.revision: Rev.C V0.4 Mar,2022 (page headers); footers read 'LGS4056H - February 2024'; PDF created 2025-07-18
lgs4056h_ds.note: 16 pages, English. Every page carries a printed page number in its footer equal to the PDF page. The formulas are set in a math font that pdftotext garbles (e.g. 'I_BAT = 900 / R_PROG' extracts as mangled glyphs), so they are read from a rendering of p.3 and p.7 and given in `figure`, not quoted. The revision history (p.2) describes 'version B' under Rev. C; the DFN package information was added in V0.4.
